title: Which Theo?

hook_line: Theo called me from two rooms at once.
first_visual: Ivy frozen in a dark hallway between a lit kitchen (left) and a black bedroom (right).

beats.visual: Earlier: Theo in bed, pinky up: 'Never turn my light off. Promise?'
beats.vo: 'Never turn my light off, Ivy-bug. Promise?'

beats.visual: Now: Ivy between two doorways: the kitchen lit (left), the bedroom black (right).
beats.vo: Theo called me from two rooms at once.

beats.visual: Ivy's head turns left, then right, as each voice calls.

ending: From the dark, in Ivy's voice: 'Theo? Come here, sweetheart.' Theo looks up at Ivy, unsure.

originality_review: Original mimic puzzle. Voice mimicry is a broad folk motif, but this avoids skinwalker framing entirely: no Indigenous lore, urban flat setting, fair-play clue. The 'it switches to your voice' ending is ours.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Ivy hears Theo call from the lit kitchen and the dark bedroom at once. The viewer chooses. The fair clue is Theo's bedtime promise: never turn off his light. The kitchen Theo is real. The thing in the dark switches to Ivy's voice to call Theo.

hooks.line: Theo called me from two rooms at once.
hooks.first_visual: Ivy frozen in a dark hallway between a lit kitchen (left) and a black bedroom (right).

hooks.line: Kitchen or bedroom? One of them isn't Theo.
The answer is in what he made me promise.
hooks.first_visual: A boy in bed holding up a pinky finger.

hooks.line: Theo never sits in the dark.
hooks.first_visual: A pitch-black bedroom with a door ajar.

hooks.line: Then it stopped using his voice. It used mine.
hooks.first_visual: Lamp-lit eyes in a dark doorway.

setting: Ivy's flat: hallway between kitchen and Theo's bedroom.
escalation: Both voices use his nickname for her; the dark one claims he is 'brave now'.
reveal: Replay of the promise: 'Never turn my light off.' Real Theo is in the light.
emotional_objective: Protective panic; a comment prompt about family passwords.
visual_requirements: hallway junction (E1 redress as flat hall)
